title: 第5章 瞎说什么大实话第6章 她真暖
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
“你体内有寒冰蛟的碎丹吧？瞧着品阶不低，远超你曾经的境界。你若活着还能压制一下，死了可就不好说了。死后尸体定然结出寒冰，火烧不化，直接埋了被妖魔惦记，怕是要消耗不少的人力物力造墓，还得有人给你守陵，直到寒气散尽，这期限少于一百年都不行。”
云珏匕首都已经压在脖颈上了，可听着她的的话，就怎么也使上不上劲。
“活着你痛苦，死了别人痛苦，你选哪个？”沈青鱼好奇问。
云珏垂眸不作声，这些人都眼瞎吗？还不赶紧把你们的长公主殿下拉开。
沈青鱼捧着他的脸，往上抬了抬，与他眼睛对视上。
【尊上，这人都被你给说抑郁了。】
沈青鱼在心头翻白眼：“可我说的是实话。”
【往往实话才最容易伤人。】
话虽如此，可她总不能一上来就问他要不是与她双修，显得她有多么饥渴似的。
不得跟他掰扯掰扯，让他自己权衡利弊，然后做出选择？
看着眼前之人浑身散发着一股求生不能，求死不得的抑郁丧气，沈青鱼其实想抽他一巴掌。
“其实你还有一个选择。”
沈青鱼说着松开手，起身退后一步。
云珏刚疑惑抬头，不料随着暖意消失寒冰爆发，他全身以肉眼可见的速度被冰冻住。
沈青鱼额上也冒了汗，体内那股燥热骤然生起。
顿时心头就有了决定，还商量个屁，直接把人扛走就是。
“小梨。”
“在！”
只一个眼神，小梨立马就知道自家殿下要做什么，冲云珏露齿一笑。

云珏心头暗道不妙，果然下一秒人就被丢到马车软塌上。
“大，冰，棍。”
“……”
内心挣扎想逃，身体却不配合。
“殿下，这般不合礼数。”
“你就说暖不暖吧。”
“暖。”
沈青鱼一脸的‘我这是为你好’，实则狂蹭寒冰之气，舒服得压根不想松手。
进城车马需要经过检查，得按规矩来，哪怕是长公主座驾也不能例外。
马车停下时，汪家一行人刚好经过，一眼便看到马顶上放着的，十分显眼的轮椅。
“那不是姓云那废物的轮椅吗？”
众人闻言，纷纷看了过来。
这时一阵风吹过，车帘被掀开一角，刚好露出云珏那张苍白的脸。
被有心人看到，立马指着马车大叫起来。
“快看，真的是云珏那个残废？他怎么会在长公主的车驾上？”
“不要脸，竟敢勾引长公主。”
“他死定了，整个上京谁人不知，长公主深爱驸马周世子，从不多看别的男子一眼。”
“可怜咯，肯定会很快就被扔下马车。”
……
听着车处喧闹，云珏转头朝枕着他腿躺着沈青鱼看去，却见她仿佛没有听到外面议论般，正拿着他的玉佩把玩。

“你就没什么要说的？”
“说什么？”
沈青鱼疑惑，抬头朝他看去。
忽地眉头微蹙：“你脸转过去点，不然这个角度刚好看到你的两个大鼻孔，怪影响美感的。”

"You have the broken elixir of the Ice Dragon in your body, right? It looks like it is of a high level, far beyond your previous realm. If you can still suppress it while alive, it will be hard to say if you die. After death, the body will definitely be covered with ice and will not be burned by fire. If you are directly buried and remembered by demons, it will take a lot of manpower and material resources to build a tomb, and someone will have to guard your tomb until the cold air dissipates. This period cannot be less than a hundred years."
Yun Jue's dagger was already pressed against his neck, but after listening to her words, he couldn't use any strength.
"It's painful for you to live, and painful for others to die. Which one do you choose?" Shen Qingyu asked curiously.
Yun Jue lowered his eyes and remained silent. Are all these people blind? Why don't you hurry up and pull your eldest princess away?
Shen Qingyu held his face, lifted it up, and looked into his eyes.
[Your Majesty, you said this person is depressed. 】
Shen Qingyu rolled his eyes in his heart: "But I am telling the truth."
【Often the truth is the easiest to hurt. 】
Having said that, she couldn't just ask him how hungry she would be if he didn't practice dual cultivation with her.
Don't you have to argue with him and let him weigh the pros and cons and make a choice?
Seeing that the person in front of him was exuding a sense of depression and despair, Shen Qingyu actually wanted to slap him.
"Actually, you still have a choice."
Shen Qingyu said, letting go of his hand, stood up and took a step back.
Yun Jue just raised his head in confusion, but unexpectedly as the warmth disappeared, ice erupted, and his whole body was frozen at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Shen Qingyu also had sweat on his forehead, and the heat in his body suddenly arose.
Immediately he made a decision in his mind, and just carried the person away without even discussing it.
"Little pear."
"Here!"
With just one look, Xiaoli immediately knew what His Highness was going to do, and gave Yun Jue a toothy smile.
Yun Jue secretly thought that something was wrong, and sure enough, the next second he was thrown onto the collapse of the carriage.
"Big, ice, stick."
"..."
My heart was struggling to escape, but my body was not cooperating.
"Your Highness, this is not polite."
"Just tell me whether it's warm or not."
"Warm."
Shen Qingyu looked like "I'm doing this for your own good", but in fact, he was rubbing the ice air so hard that he felt so comfortable that he didn't even want to let go.
Cars and horses entering the city need to be inspected and must follow the rules, even the princess's car is no exception.
When the carriage stopped, the Wang family happened to pass by, and at a glance they saw a very conspicuous wheelchair placed on the top of the horse.
"Isn't that the useless wheelchair named Yun Na?"
After hearing this, everyone looked over.
At this time, a gust of wind blew by, and a corner of the car curtain was lifted, just revealing Yun Jue's pale face.
When someone saw it, he immediately pointed at the carriage and shouted.
"Look, is it really that cripple Yun Jue? Why is he in the eldest princess's car?"
"Shameless, how dare you seduce the eldest princess."
"He is dead. Everyone in Beijing knows that the eldest princess loves her consort Zhou Shizi so much that she never looks at other men."
"It's pitiful. He will definitely be thrown off the carriage soon."
…
Listening to the noise in the car, Yun Jue turned to look at Shen Qingyu, who was lying on his leg, and saw that she was playing with his jade pendant as if she hadn't heard the discussion outside.
"You have nothing to say?"
"What did you say?"
Shen Qingyu was confused and looked up at him.
Suddenly he frowned and said, "Turn your face away, otherwise your two big nostrils will be visible from this angle, which will affect your beauty."
